nodes.description: IERC1155 public nft token contract reference set in constructor to 0x13bAb10a88fc5F6c77b87878d71c9F1707D2688A
uint256 public price = 0.2 ether, unit price per NFT unit
uint256 public id, ERC1155 token id set to 36 in constructor
address payable public multisig, recipient of the contract ETH balance
uint256 public start, sale start timestamp used in the time gate
constructor(address payable _multisig, uint256 _start) sets multisig, start, nft and id
buy(uint256 amount) public payable, validates caller, timing, supply and payment then transfers NFT and ETH
supply() public view returns the contract NFT balance for id
onERC1155Received external pure ERC1155 receiver hook returning the selector
Caller address used in the no-contracts check and as the NFT recipient
Block timestamp compared against the start variable for the sale gate
Transaction origin compared to msg.sender to block contract callers
External call nft.safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, id, amount, new bytes(0x0)) that can invoke a receiver callback
External ETH transfer multisig.transfer(address(this).balance) sending the full contract balance
Arithmetic price.mul(amount) computing the required payment value
uint256 amount parameter of buy(uint256 amount), number of NFT units to purchase
address payable _multisig constructor parameter assigned to the multisig state variable
uint256 _start constructor parameter assigned to the start state variable
new bytes(0x0) empty calldata argument constructed for the safeTransferFrom call

edges.reason: nft state variable provides the IERC1155 instance used for the external safeTransferFrom call
price state variable is the multiplicand in price.mul(amount)
id state variable is passed as the token id argument to safeTransferFrom
multisig state variable is the destination of the ETH transfer
start gates buy execution through require(block.timestamp >= start)
msg.sender participation is enforced by require(msg.sender == tx.origin) and used as the NFT recipient
tx.origin is used as the trusted origin in the require(msg.sender == tx.origin) guard
block.timestamp controls whether buy proceeds under the start gate
amount parameter flows through buy and drives validation, emit and transfer logic
amount is the multiplier operand in the price.mul(amount) arithmetic validation
amount is passed unchanged as the value argument to safeTransferFrom
the price.mul result is compared to msg.value in require(msg.value == price.mul(amount))
buy calls supply() in the require(amount <= supply()) check
buy performs the external nft.safeTransferFrom call before completing ETH payout
buy performs the external multisig.transfer ETH payout after the NFT transfer
safeTransferFrom invokes the ERC1155 receiver hook on the recipient, potentially re-entering the sale contract
_multisig is a constructor parameter controlling constructor initialization
_multisig is assigned into the multisig state variable
_start is a constructor parameter controlling constructor initialization
_start is assigned into the start state variable
the empty bytes local is passed as the data argument to safeTransferFrom

normalization_plan.reason: amount is a non-core parameter that exists solely to serve the buy function and should be merged into it
_multisig is a non-core constructor parameter used only to initialize the contract state
_start is a non-core constructor parameter used only to initialize the contract state
new bytes(0x0) is a transient local constructed only as the data argument of the external safeTransferFrom call
